name: Gemini
notes: Refers to Gemini CLI, which reads local project/user configuration from ~/.gemini/. Skills are installed as a plain SKILL.md folder under ~/.gemini/skills/<skill-name>/, mirroring the Claude Code / Codex convention. Not independently lab-tested against a live Gemini CLI install, so skill.json compatibility is 'supported' rather than 'native'. Does not apply to the remote Gemini web app, which has no file-based skill loading.
